examples.text: The construction flaw is incorrigible; any attempt to amend it would cause a complete collapse.

glosses: Incurably depraved; not reformable.

examples.text: His dark soul was too incorrigible to repent, even at his execution.

glosses: Unchangeably established in a belief or habit.

examples.text: Gordon Brown may have his grumpy, Granita moments, but as a strategist he is an incorrigible optimist.

glosses: Intrinsically incapable of being corrected; impossible to disprove, by its very nature.

examples.text: The statement "My knee hurts" is incorrigible.

glosses: Impossible to cure.

examples.text: It may appear as an epidemic, as a hereditary complaint, or as an obstinate and incorrigible disease again and again recurring.
